newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea central bank sells dlrs at 893.00-892.60.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea central bank sells dlrs at 893.00-892.60.

text.p: South Korea's central bank sold dollars at 893.00-892.60 won at the start of Wednesday afternoon trading to limit the fall of the local currency, dealers said.
It was the fourth intervention of the day, dealers said. The won is under pressure as a result of a financial crisis at the Kia Group, which has been rescued by creditors.
The won opened for the afternoon at its day's low of 893.00, prompting the intervention, dealers said.
They said dollar buying to cover short positions was further weakening the won, but the dealers predicted the won would not fall below the 893 level.
The Bank of Korea sold dollars at 892.40 won shortly after the market opened, then sold one-year forward dollars at 919 won and sold again on the spot market at around 892.50, dealers said.
